speaker: richard_field
text: Will? Richard Field. From the shop, and I've a thing to say I'd liefer have said a fortnight since.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it, then. I am only just in the door, and the paint is not on.

speaker: richard_field
text: I saw Burby's entry in the Hall book, with mine own eyes. That's two of thine gone to press by other men's hands inside a twelvemonth, Millington's and now this. And thou'lt tell me again they're not thine to print.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then write me what is. A third poem. The press stands idle Fridays, and I'm tired of saying it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have a duke in hand, Dick. Four lovers. And a weaver.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: God may start with the head. The jaw has to move, or the galleries will not hear him. That is as far as I am.

speaker: richard_field
text: A jaw will not fill a Friday. Come on Sunday. St Thomas's. Dinner after sermon, before thou goest up to the court. Jacqueline will have a goose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sunday. I will come. I am not on a boat until the week after.

speaker: richard_field
text: And the king is played, Will. Thou canst have no more use for the second volume.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There's more in it than one king, Richard.
